entities.summary: Jyoti Hegde is a Rudra veena and sitar artist from the Khandarbani gharana. She has pursued music since age 12 and completed her master's in music from Karnatak University of Dharwad. Vidhushi Jyoti Hegde is the first woman player of Rudra veena in the world. She is a Grade-A artist of the Rudra veena and sitar with the All India Radio and regularly sought after for concerts.
